mapper.select: select d.season_id as seasonId, d.id as divisionId, s.series_name as seriesName, se.display_title as seasonTitle, d.division_name as divisionName, d.platform_code as platformCode, d.registration_mode as registrationMode, d.game_mode as gameMode, d.lineup_min_count as lineupMinCount, d.lineup_max_count as lineupMaxCount, d.max_person_count as maxPersonCount, (select count(1) from basket_personal_registration pr2 where pr2.division_id = d.id and pr2.registration_status = 'APPROVED' and pr2.is_delete = 0) as approvedPersonCount, case when d.max_person_count is null then null else greatest(d.max_person_count - (select count(1) from basket_personal_registration pr3 where pr3.division_id = d.id and pr3.registration_status = 'APPROVED' and pr3.is_delete = 0), 0) end as remainingPersonCount, d.registration_start_time as registrationStartTime, d.registration_end_time as registrationEndTime, d.match_start_time as matchStartTime, d.match_end_time as matchEndTime, mr.registration_status as myRegistrationStatus from basket_division d inner join basket_season se on se.id = d.season_id and se.is_delete = 0 and se.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' inner join basket_series s on s.id = se.series_id and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_personal_registration mr on mr.division_id = d.id and mr.player_id = #{playerId} and mr.is_delete = 0 and mr.active_unique_key is not null where d.is_delete = 0 and d.division_status = 'REGISTRATION_OPEN' and d.registration_mode = 'PERSONAL' order by d.sort_order asc, d.id desc

select pr.id as personalRegistrationId, pr.season_id as seasonId, pr.division_id as divisionId, se.display_title as seasonTitle, d.division_name as divisionName, d.platform_code as platformCode, pr.preferred_position as preferredPosition, pr.registration_status as registrationStatus, pr.submit_time as submitTime, pr.approved_time as approvedTime, pr.reject_reason as rejectReason, pr.assigned_draw_team_id as assignedDrawTeamId, pr.converted_registration_id as convertedRegistrationId, dt.temporary_team_name as assignedTemporaryTeamName, coalesce(cp.game_nickname, mp.nickname) as assignedCaptainName, case when b.batch_status in ('LOCKED', 'CONVERTED') then 1 else 0 end as formationLocked from basket_personal_registration pr left join basket_season se on se.id = pr.season_id and se.is_delete = 0 left join basket_division d on d.id = pr.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_personal_draw_team dt on dt.id = pr.assigned_draw_team_id and dt.is_delete = 0 left join basket_personal_draw_batch b on b.id = dt.draw_batch_id and b.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile cp on cp.id = dt.captain_player_id and cp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = dt.captain_user_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where pr.is_delete = 0 and pr.user_id = #{memberId} order by pr.update_time desc, pr.id desc
